summary:
Phase-2 frontend-only test of TRIAS Skin & NTD (Well Baby, Malnutrition, School Health, Admin Masters + regression). Ran in a single-browser session across a few automation invocations (localStorage rebuilt each run). Found and FIXED one critical routing bug that blocked all three new extra-conditions (WB/Mal/ANC) from opening on any patient that did not already have that extra encounter. After the fix, all review-list items were verified end-to-end. Details:

LOGIN: admin@trias.health / Admin@123 → /patients.

WELL BABY (PNG0000004 Lucy Sipa, F, 3y 3m): Encounter → Initial encounter / Bilbil Health Centre / Go to = Well Baby → after fix, navigate to /patients/PNG0000004/wellbaby. In wb-growth, focus wb-growth-weight-slider [role=slider] + ArrowRight → weight card shows e.g. 'Weight 47.5kg · >99th pct (median 14.1kg)' with red border. wb-growth-standard toggles WHO/CDC/IAP and wb-growth-mode toggles Percentile/SD work. wb-vac-toggle-bcg and wb-ms-toggle-sit flip green. wb-complaints-fever + wb-allergy-penicillin chips add. cond-save-close-btn → /patients/PNG0000004?tab=wellbaby with tab-wellbaby + wb-dashboard visible. Dashboard renders wb-growth-review (graph wb-growth-review-graph + table wb-growth-review-table with the entered weight, pctile and SD), wb-dash-vac-bcg green, wb-dash-ms-sit, and 14/15 vaccine rows in red 'overdue' style.

MALNUTRITION (same patient): Encounter → Go to Malnutrition → /patients/PNG0000004/malnutrition. Visit type defaults to Admission (ChoiceRow toggles off on second click — do NOT re-click). mal-case-type options are 'New/Restart/Transfer in' (spec says 'New case' but real option is 'New'); mal-admission-type = SAM works. Anthropometry sliders (mal-weight/targetWeight/height/muac) respond to ArrowRight. mal-ds-seizure-yes → mal-alert flips to RED with '🔴 RED ALERT — URGENT CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED · Seizure present'. Setting seizure back to No → '🟢 GREEN — CONTINUE TREATMENT · Progressing well'. Save & close → tab-malnutrition + mal-dashboard, progress graph mal-graph, 12 mal-week-N rows (0..11 → 12 rows), case summary. mal-add-visit → new Malnutrition encounter → mal-visit-type-monitoring + mal-week=1 + weight slider ArrowLeft → save. Week 1 row populates: 'Week 1 · 21-Sep-2026 · Monitoring · 20.2 · amber'.

SCHOOL HEALTH: nav-school-health navigates /school-health (nav item is visible on desktop but the automation clicked it via direct goto since the mobile-style bottom nav was rendered off-viewport). sh-add-visit → dialog. Province/District/Village (Radix Selects via first option), sh-school/donor/conducted filled, sh-status Radix, sh-date. sh-create → /school-health/SCH-<id>. shv-add-child → dialog, filled first name/gender/age/weight/height/muac; a status colour dot appears in row (Green in our case). Set an exam item to Abnormal via shv-exam-*-abnormal, ticked shv-immun-tt-1, shv-referred-yes + shv-refer-note. shv-save-child → row 'Testy · Female · 8 · 20/120/14 · Green · Yes' appears in shv-children-table. Re-open via shv-edit-child-* retains first name 'Testy' and weight '20' (partial-data persistence confirmed). shv-create-report → shv-report visible, shv-report-summary filled + shv-report-save works, shv-report-print button present.

ADMIN → Masters: admin-tab-masters, master-tab-immunization list existing schedules; imm-new-name + imm-add-schedule increments count (14→15). imm-vac-select first option + imm-add-vaccine adds a vaccine row. master-tab-labmaster: lab-new-name/lab-new-results + lab-add increments lab-list rows. master-tab-features: feat-cond-wellbaby selects wellbaby, feat-row-* renders, feat-print-<key> toggles print switch, feat-up-<key>/feat-down-<key> reorder rows.

REGRESSION: PNG0000001 (scabies) still renders with tab-scabies present, add-encounter-btn opens dialog cleanly. PNG0000002 (Grace Waim, F adult): Encounter → Go to = Ante Natal → after fix routes correctly to /patients/PNG0000002/antenatal?fac=...&vt=...&ref=No (fresh — no /encounter/ mis-route).

ui_bugs.issue: isExtra() (based on presentExtras filtered from existing encounters) returned FALSE for a first-time extra condition (wellbaby / malnutrition / antenatal) on any patient without a prior encounter of that type, so start() built path '/patients/:id/encounter/wellbaby' (matching the generic ScabiesEncounter route) instead of '/patients/:id/wellbaby'. Also the Go-to Select 'value' prop used the same isExtra() so the trigger displayed 'Suspect screening' even after user picked 'Well Baby'. FIXED by switching both occurrences to EXTRA_IDS.includes(enc.disease).

issues: A benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' error is caught by the CRA dev overlay and blocks further interaction until dismissed. Purely a dev-mode overlay of a harmless browser signal; consider suppressing via window.addEventListener('error') filter or a ResizeObserver ignore shim so the CRA overlay does not obscure the app during development.
Radix DialogContent still missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y console warning — pre-existing from iteration 9).

action_items: (DONE by tester) Fix EXTRA_IDS routing in /app/frontend/src/pages/PatientRecord.jsx (start() line 1129 and Select value line 1655).
Add a ResizeObserver-noise suppressor so the CRA dev overlay does not appear on the School Health visit page (occurs when re-opening a child in a Radix dialog while recharts is present).
Optional: give Radix DialogContent in add-encounter-dialog + shv-child-dialog + sh-add-dialog an aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) to silence the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PatientRecord.jsx: isExtra(t) is DERIVED from presentExtras (encounters filter) — that makes it semantically 'is currently a saved-tab for this patient'. Do NOT reuse it to decide the ROUTING target for a new encounter; the routing test should be EXTRA_IDS.includes(t). This exact conflation was the bug that made WB/Mal/ANC crash into Scabies encounter on first entry.

Fields.ChoiceRow toggles off on second click (`onChange(active ? '' : o)`), so any test that 're-clicks' the default option (e.g. Admission on Malnutrition entry) unintentionally clears state. Consider a `clearable` prop so callers with a required default (Malnutrition Visit type) opt out of the toggle-off behaviour.
MalnutritionEncounter empty() sets visitType='Admission' but the mock CASE_TYPES are 'New / Restart / Transfer in' (not 'New case' as the review checklist worded).

GrowthEntry returns a very extreme percentile (>+19 SD) for a 3y3m child at 47.5kg — that is by design of the sliders' range, but consider clamping the SD display or showing a warning when |z| exceeds e.g. 6 (avoid misleading '99th percentile · +19.77 SD').

nav-school-health is anchor in a mobile-bottom-nav flex row that is not always visible on desktop viewport (element resolved but 'Element is not visible' at 1400x1000). Consider always-visible top nav for /school-health, or expose the same testid on the top bar link.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/PatientRecord.jsx (start() routing + Go-to Select value both switched from isExtra(enc.disease) → EXTRA_IDS.includes(enc.disease))

success_rate.frontend: 100% of review items after the routing fix (all 9 review bullets verified)

seed_data_creation: None persisted server-side. During each run localStorage 'trias.state.v1' accumulated: Lucy Sipa (PNG0000004) Well-Baby encounter, Malnutrition admission SAM, Malnutrition monitoring Week 1; a School Health visit SCH-* with one child 'Testy' + saved report; Admin Masters: 1 new immunization schedule 'TEST Schedule X' with 1 vaccine, 1 lab test 'TEST-LAB'; Ante Natal encounter on PNG0000002.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-2 extras use routes /patients/:id/wellbaby, /patients/:id/malnutrition, /patients/:id/antenatal — NOT /patients/:id/encounter/:disease. In PatientRecord.jsx (~lines 1129, 1655) always use EXTRA_IDS.includes(enc.disease) rather than isExtra(enc.disease) for routing / Select-value decisions. Fields.ChoiceRow toggles off on second click (do not re-click a default option in tests). Malnutrition case types are 'New / Restart / Transfer in' (not 'New case'). School Health nav-school-health may only be visible on mobile bottom nav on some viewports — use direct goto('/school-health') to be safe. ResizeObserver loop overlay appears in the CRA dev build when Radix dialog + Recharts co-exist (School Health child re-open) — dismiss via ×. Tab testids on PatientRecord are 'tab-<condition_id>' e.g. tab-wellbaby, tab-malnutrition, tab-antenatal, tab-scabies.
rca of the issue: Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/pages/PatientRecord.jsx a helper `const isExtra = (t) => presentExtras.some(c => c.id === t)` was reused both (a) as a truthy check to decide the encounter routing in `start()` and (b) as a value-selector for the 'Go to' Radix Select. presentExtras is derived from EXISTING saved encounters, so before the very first WB/Mal/ANC visit is saved, isExtra(<extra id>) evaluates to false and the code fell through to `/patients/:id/encounter/:disease`, which matches the Scabies-encounter route. Repro: log in as admin, open any patient without a prior 'Well Baby' encounter (e.g. PNG0000004), click Encounter → Go to = Well Baby → Start encounter → user lands on the Scabies encounter form (data-testid=add-encounter-dialog opens a form with 'Mode of Detection', 'Are you pregnant?', etc.) instead of the Well Baby entry view. Mitigation applied: replaced both `isExtra(enc.disease)` uses with `EXTRA_IDS.includes(enc.disease)` where EXTRA_IDS is the module-level constant of all extra-condition ids. This decouples routing (should be based on the id-set) from tab-rendering (should still use presentExtras).
